digest.component_or_area: author guide and user documentation for plan-review criteria
propositions: Author guides incorrectly describe Success Criteria as a distinct, required heading for containers, instructing authors to write sections that the collapsed vocabulary no longer reads.
The leaf vs container guidance must be rewritten to express container requirements as decomposition coverage and testing deferral rather than as a renamed heading, avoiding vacuous instructions.

All Success Criteria vocabulary must be removed from shipped guide artifacts (writing-a-passing-plan.md, user-guide.md, llm-framework.md) while preserving four permanent carve-outs (pilot/trial language, dod_uncertifiable concept).
After vocabulary collapse, rebar explain plan must render the updated guide with zero Success Criteria vocabulary and the container section must still convey a distinct, meaningful requirement.
